relationship.formal_sglang_runtime: Not selected for Phase 2 instrumentation; its audited recurrent INT8-R128 semantics are matched (FP32 cache, per-token post-update QDQ, vR, output R^T).
relationship.historical_diagnostic_runtime: Selected because it exposes recurrent states, local out_proj outputs, final hidden states, and logits without changing weights.
relationship.training_runtime: Reuses the exact historical Transformers full-path probe stack and metric definitions used by recurrent_dense_train.py.
